notes.title: Serra de Deus – Upcoming Simulation & Psychological Horror Game!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3868630/
Hello Steam Community! A few months ago i started working on a new game called 'Serra de Deus'.

Genre/Theme: Serra de Deus is a simulation and adventure game with elements of psychological horror. It features a retro aesthetic with PS1-style graphics.

Synopsis: After years living in the bustling city of São Paulo, David de Lima decides to return to his hometown, Rio de Janeiro, where he takes over his family’s humble hot dog cart. However, the peace doesn’t last long. David soon realizes that things have changed — a series of strange murders have taken place, and the more he investigates, the more questions arise. These crimes don’t seem to have been committed by gangs or ordinary criminals, but by something far more sinister: a mysterious group of cultists.

Protagonist: David de Lima is a 25-year-old from Rio de Janeiro, who graduated in engineering in the city of São Paulo. However, due to difficulties finding a job, David decides to return to the favela where he grew up, Serra de Deus.

Location: Serra de Deus is a fictional favela/community located on the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro. Despite facing common issues found in Brazilian outskirts, such as poverty and drug trafficking, this community was relatively peaceful until very recently, when the murders began.

Use of AI: In my previous game, Terminal 81R, many people didn’t like the fact that I used a lot of AI-generated images, textures, and music. I want you to know that I’ve heard the criticism and have been learning a lot since then. For this reason, I’ve decided that Serra de Deus will not have AI-generated art — I will strive to use 100% human-made art.

Please, add the game to your wishlist if you are interested!

notes.title: The sequel to Terminal 81 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow gamers!

This post is to announce that the sequel to Terminal 81, called Terminal 81R, has been released and is now available for purchase and download on Steam! (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377530/Terminal_81R/) I invite you to return to Terminal 81, eight years after the events of the original game, and explore a city that has been completely revolutionized with improvements in every way, while still maintaining that dark and mysterious atmosphere.

A big thank you to everyone who has waited, as well as to those who have already purchased or plan to purchase the game. Remember, if you’d like to talk to me, you can do so through my Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/AygFDaujxC.

Also, if you haven’t followed my Steam creator page yet, I encourage you to do so! https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42918923.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Retrospective on Terminal 81
notes.notes:
In a few months, it will be a year since I launched Terminal 81 on Steam, and since then the game has received a very good reception that has left me very surprised. I really can't find enough words to thank everyone who bought and played the video game. When I started creating Terminal 81, I didn't think it would be played by so many people. I also want to apologize for not being able to thank you with something better, like a DLC or a big update. I am really busy lately.

Thank you very much to everyone. This message, first of all, is to thank you all, and secondly, I wanted to let you know that I have not forgotten about you and I have not forgotten about this game. I already have a script written for a sequel, however, at the moment, I am not working on this sequel because I am busy working on another project. But as soon as I finish this project, I will definitely start working on the sequel. Again, thank you all very much. Remember that if any of you have a problem with any of my games or want to make suggestions, or anything else, you can talk to me through Discord.

https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Terminal 81 - 1.3.0 Minor Update
notes.notes:
-International translations have been completely redone from scratch. Now, translations to Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean should contain significantly fewer grammatical errors.

-Added a small tutorial explaining how to navigate the inventory.

-The game can now check from the start if any Steam achievements are missing. In case you unlock an achievement in the game but not on Steam, restarting the game should resolve this.


(Redoing the translations was a challenging task that accidentally broke some codes. Nevertheless, I made a significant effort to test and fix all the bugs caused by the improvement of the translations. However, as previously mentioned, this was a tough job for a single person. So, if you encounter any bugs or errors after updating to this version, please report them on the Discord server).

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/93ba38DdhF

I just uploaded a revision of the 1.2.2 patch in which the problem that makes some people not unlock some of the steam achievements should be fixed.
